Item Class: Jewels
Rarity: Rare
Soul Shard
Medium Cluster Jewel
--------
Requirements:
Level: 40
--------
Item Level: 68
--------
{ Enchant Modifier }
Adds 4 Passive Skills
(All Added Passive Skills are Small unless otherwise specified) (Added Passive Skills are never considered to be in Radius by other Jewels)
{ Enchant Modifier }
1 Added Passive Skill is a Jewel Socket
{ Enchant Modifier }
Added Small Passive Skills grant:
Minions have 12% increased maximum Life
--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Vivid" (Tier: 2) — Attribute }
Added Small Passive Skills also grant: +2(2-3) to All Attributes
{ Prefix Modifier "Potent" (Tier: 1) }
Added Small Passive Skills have 25(25-35)% increased Effect
{ Prefix Modifier "of the Undead" }
1 Added Passive Skill is Life from Death
--------
Place into an allocated Medium or Large Jewel Socket on the Passive Skill Tree. Added passives do not interact with jewel radiuses. Right click to remove from the Socket.
